en.title: Minimum Adjacent Change Cost After Replacing !
en.description: You are given a string S containing only 0, 1 and !. Each ! can independently be replaced with 0 or 1. After the replacement, every adjacent pair 01 costs x, every adjacent pair 10 costs y, and every other adjacent pair costs 0. Find the minimum total cost.
en.input: The first line of input is S (length 1..100000, containing at least one !). The second line contains the non-negative 32-bit integers x and y.
en.explanation: For each position you only need the minimum prefix cost with the current position set to 0 or to 1; each transition only looks at the newly added last pair of characters.
hints: Let dp[b] be the minimum cost after processing up to the current position, with the current position set to b.
